name: UI Manager
author: Brett
description: Select any UI element in the whole console and edit every property and token it reads, choosing from predetermined values the console and the framework supply (asset ids, enums, colour tokens, ranges): never free text where a list exists. Collapsible categories; 'On screen now' lists what is visible as shortcuts to the same element. Live preview, reset to skin / default, overrides shown, change log with undo. Core rules: framework/core/engines/ui-manager-rules.mjs (ui-element@1, ui-overrides@1, ui-change@1).

items.title: List selectable elements
items.description: Search, sort and multi-filter every UI element the UI Manager can select, with its category and how many overrides it carries. q = words; kinds, categories, plugins = comma lists (any of them); overridden / onScreen = only changed / only on screen (visible = ids on screen now); sort = label, kind, category, plugin or overrides; desc; limit / offset page it. facets = every filter value with its count.

items.title: Element tree
items.description: The collapsible categories. 'On screen now' lists shortcuts to the elements whose ids are passed as visible.

items.title: Properties and tokens of an element
items.description: The expanding row: every property and token with its value, base, source (override / skin / asset / default) and choices.

items.title: Valid values of a property
items.description: The predetermined values of one property: asset ids, enum words, colour tokens (@accent …), a range with a step. Never free text.

items.title: Set a property
items.description: Set one property of one element to one of its choices and save it (one change-log entry). Anything outside the list is refused with the valid values.

items.title: Properties of an element by id
items.description: The same as props, with the id as ?id= (live console targets carry slashes: target:view:builds/button:save).

items.title: Set a property (body)
items.description: The same as set, with { element, prop, value } in the body, for any element id including live console targets.

items.title: Window state
items.description: The UI Manager window's selected element and view (row, panel or grid); the open window follows changes made through the API.

items.title: Select an element
items.description: Select an element by id, label or words ('main toolbar'); the open window shows it. console_action ui-manager.select:<words> does the same in the open console and opens the window.

items.title: Choose the view
items.description: How a selected element opens: row (expanding row, default), panel (side panel) or grid (cards).

items.title: Say it
items.description: What a person says, run step by step with the same validated set and reset: 'select the main toolbar, set its transparency to 80', 'set the variant of the toolbar to labels', 'reset transparency of the toolbar', 'grid view'. Voice (AmberX) sends the words here.

items.title: Reset to skin / default
items.description: Drop the override of one property, of one element, or of everything.

items.title: Live preview plan
items.description: CSS on tokens, asset swaps and patches for a pending overrides document (or the saved one), plus the exit summary (element, property, old → new).

items.title: Validate pending changes
items.description: Every problem in a pending ui-overrides@1 document (unknown element, unknown property, value outside its choices); empty = valid. Nothing is saved.

items.title: JSON Schemas
items.description: The JSON Schemas of ui-element@1, ui-overrides@1 and ui-change@1.

items.title: Apply pending changes
items.description: Save a whole pending ui-overrides@1 document as one change-log entry; every value is checked against its choices first.

items.title: Change log
items.description: Every applied change: who, when, element, property, old → new; undone entries marked.

items.title: Undo a change
items.description: Put every property of one change-log entry back to its previous value.

items.title: Export the UI as an asset library
items.description: Export any UI as an asset library (ui-library@1): the assets the chosen elements read (patched with the changes made here, under new ids), the token values they set and a manifest (asset per slot, hidden, transparency), schema-validated. elements = ids, labels or words (default: everything changed; all = every element with an asset). publish = into the shared hub library; skin = also the skin@1 asset it makes. The answer names the package file (library/{id}/download).

items.title: Libraries on the hub
items.description: Every asset library in the shared hub library (ui-library-index@1): id, name, version, who, when, how many elements, assets and tokens.

items.title: One library
items.description: One asset library from the shared hub library; skin=true adds the skin@1 asset it makes.

items.title: Download a library package
items.description: The downloadable package of one library: <id>.ui-library.json, importable into any app, project or skin.

items.title: Validate a library package
items.description: Every problem in a ui-library@1 document against the schema rules and this console's catalog; empty = valid. Nothing is saved.

items.title: Import a library
items.description: Import a library (id on the hub, or the package as library) into: framework (the shared set every listed and every future app bakes), app (dir = the app folder), project (dir = the folder), skin (a skin@1 asset), console (assets into the UI Manager's assets folder, overrides applied as one change). plan = only list the files; force = replace files that exist.
